_comment: Sample 'My Project' beads-graph plan — a fictional time-tracking SaaS demonstrating a 2-3 tier app dev project. Three milestones (MVP, Beta, 1.0), six epics across frontend/backend/data/auth/deploy/billing tiers, ~30 work items with realistic dependency edges. Loaded by examples/my-project/load.sh; consumed by scripts/generate-readme-screenshots.ts to produce the README's dark-mode screenshots. See gm-57p6.

nodes.title: MVP
nodes.description: Single user can sign up, log time entries, and see a daily report. Everything below this milestone must ship for the demo.

nodes.title: Beta Release
nodes.description: Public beta — multi-user accounts, exports, deploy pipeline, basic ops. Stable enough to invite friendly users.

nodes.title: 1.0 Launch
nodes.description: Paid tiers, billing webhooks, polish. Production-ready.

nodes.title: Frontend SPA
nodes.description: React + Vite + TypeScript shell. Renders the time-entry form, the report dashboard, and the auth-guarded routes once auth lands.

nodes.title: Backend API
nodes.description: Go HTTP service exposing entries + reports endpoints. Deliberately thin: validation in handlers, repos own SQL.

nodes.title: Data Layer
nodes.description: SQLite schema for MVP, with a migration path to Postgres in beta. Repos isolate the rest of the codebase from SQL details.

nodes.title: Auth & Accounts
nodes.description: Signup, login, session cookies, JWT for API, password reset. Per-user isolation across repos.

nodes.title: Deploy & Ops
nodes.description: Multi-stage Docker, GitHub Actions CI, Postgres swap, healthcheck, structured logs. Whatever it takes to keep the beta lights on.

nodes.title: Billing & Plans
nodes.description: Stripe integration: plan selection, subscriptions, upgrades, downgrades, invoice email. Production gating happens here.

nodes.title: Vite + React + TypeScript scaffold
nodes.description: Bootstrap web/ with Vite, install React, TypeScript, Tailwind. `pnpm dev` works.

nodes.title: Router + AppShell layout
nodes.description: react-router routes, sidebar + topbar shell, responsive grid container.

nodes.title: Auth-guarded private routes
nodes.description: RequireAuth wrapper, redirects to /login when token absent.

nodes.title: Time-entry form (date / duration / project / notes)
nodes.description: Controlled form, optimistic submit, validation echoed from API.

nodes.title: Daily report dashboard
nodes.description: Table + summary tiles. Reads /api/reports?day=YYYY-MM-DD.

nodes.title: Design system tokens (colors, spacing, type)
nodes.description: Centralize Tailwind theme + semantic tokens. Drives the AppShell + every page.

nodes.title: Go server skeleton (cmd/server)
nodes.description: main.go with graceful shutdown, signal handling, http.Server config.

nodes.title: chi router + middleware chain
nodes.description: Logger, recoverer, request-id middleware. Mounted under /api.

nodes.title: /api/entries CRUD endpoints
nodes.description: POST / GET / PATCH / DELETE for time entries. Per-user when auth lands.

nodes.title: /api/reports daily aggregator
nodes.description: Group entries by day; return tile metrics + a row list.

nodes.title: Validation middleware (entry shape, duration limits)
nodes.description: Reject invalid bodies with structured errors; one place, every endpoint.

nodes.title: SQLite schema design (entries, users, sessions)
nodes.description: Tables, indices, constraints. Reviewed for migration headroom to Postgres.

nodes.title: Migration runner (forward-only with checksums)
nodes.description: Embed sql/ migrations, run on boot, refuse mismatched checksums.

nodes.title: Repos: entries + users
nodes.description: Typed repos isolating callers from SQL. Returns errors, not driver leaks.

nodes.title: Connection pooling config
nodes.description: MaxOpenConns / MaxIdleConns / lifetimes, sized for SQLite (1 writer) and Postgres later.

nodes.title: Signup flow (email + password)
nodes.description: Form + endpoint + verification email stub. Argon2id hashing.

nodes.title: Login + session cookies
nodes.description: Set-Cookie with Secure + HttpOnly + SameSite=Lax. Server-side session table.

nodes.title: Password reset email
nodes.description: Tokenized reset link, 1-hour TTL, single-use.

nodes.title: JWT for API auth (cookie → bearer)
nodes.description: Mint short-lived JWT from session cookie for /api/* calls.

nodes.title: Per-user data isolation across repos
nodes.description: Every repo query takes user_id; tests prove cross-user reads return zero rows.

nodes.title: Multi-stage Dockerfile (Go + embedded SPA)
nodes.description: Builder stage compiles Go + builds SPA; final stage is distroless with the embedded binary.

nodes.title: GitHub Actions CI (test, lint, build)
nodes.description: On push/PR: go test -race, golangci-lint, pnpm lint, build artifacts.

nodes.title: Postgres swap (replace SQLite for beta)
nodes.description: Drop the SQLite-only assumptions; migration runner handles either.

nodes.title: Healthcheck endpoint /health
nodes.description: Returns 200 + version + db-ping result. Wired to the load balancer.

nodes.title: Structured logging (slog + JSON)
nodes.description: Replace fmt.Println with slog; one log/request, stable field names.

nodes.title: Stripe account + product catalog
nodes.description: Set up products + prices (free / pro / team). Live + test keys via env.

nodes.title: Plan selection UI
nodes.description: Three-tile pricing page; Stripe Checkout redirect on select.

nodes.title: Subscription webhook handler
nodes.description: Verify signature, idempotent on customer.subscription.* events.

nodes.title: Upgrade / downgrade flow
nodes.description: Proration handled by Stripe; UI confirms before applying.

nodes.title: Invoice email + PDF
nodes.description: Listen for invoice.paid, render PDF, email via the same provider as auth.

edges._comment: Design-system tokens want layout decisions, while the layout also references tokens. Keep one side as a non-blocking relationship so modern bd accepts the graph as a DAG.
